bugs.short: PDR-A 16.8.0 - [AIAgent] AI Mini Drama: Surprise me appends the same inspiration on every tap
bugs.creator: ETHAN_HSU
bugs.desc:

1. Launch the APP

4. Tap Surprise me
5. Tap Surprise me
